title: Activity log, protected from changes
description: A record of what happened on the network and in the console, with each entry linked to the one before so changes can be detected.

actions.createCheckpoint: Save a signed snapshot of the log
actions.siemTargets: Send events to an external system

stats.validBadge: Every entry matches the one before
stats.partialBadge: Older entries do not cover every field
stats.eventsHint: Changes can be detected: each entry is linked to the one before
stats.adminOnlyHint: Verification available to the super-admin only

filters.searchPlaceholder: Search by text, event type, user, IP address...

verifyModal.title: Integrity check result
verifyModal.subtitle: The check recalculates every fingerprint and compares it with the stored one, across the whole log.
verifyModal.validDesc: Entries match their stored fingerprints. Attribution to organisations is shown below.
verifyModal.partialHeadline: Log intact, but older entries are only partly verified
verifyModal.partialDesc: The links between entries are correct. Older entries do not protect every field, so a change to those fields would not be detected.
verifyModal.unknownHeadline: Links are correct, but it is unknown which fields are protected
verifyModal.unknownDesc: The server does not say which fields are protected, so this report cannot confirm that all data is safe.
verifyModal.emptyDesc: There is nothing to check yet.
verifyModal.attributionUnavailable: Organization attribution is unavailable or incomplete in this server report.
verifyModal.tamperedHeadline: Possible tampering: the log does not add up
verifyModal.tamperedDesc: The check found an entry that does not match its fingerprint. Do not use this log as evidence until it is explained. Tell the security lead.

checkpointModal.title: Save a signed snapshot of the log
checkpointModal.description: Signs the latest entry with the system key. It shows later what the log looked like at this moment.

siemModal.title: Send events to external security systems
siemModal.subtitle: Copies log events to security monitoring tools (for example Splunk, Elastic, IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel).
siemModal.noTargets: No destination set up. No events are sent to external systems.

exportModal.title: Download the activity log
exportModal.description: Download events to review them. The JSON package also includes the latest integrity check result, when available.
exportModal.complianceSeal: Before relying on the exported log, read the integrity check result: older entries may be only partly verified.

empty.title: No events recorded
empty.desc: Administrator actions, device changes and security events will appear here.
empty.noMatches: Change the search or the severity to see more events.

errors.checkpoint: The snapshot was not created. Try again shortly.
errors.siem: The destination was not added. Check the address and format, then try again.
errors.siemRequired: Write a name and an address.
errors.siemRemove: The destination was not removed. Try again.
